purpose: Interrogate the already-frozen source-rule atlas as a discovery surface rather than treating the original positive-transfer rubric as the only scientifically meaningful view of the evidence.

signedRelationalStateExperiment.question: Do any learned relational transitions behave as exclusions or prohibitions, not merely attractions?
signedRelationalStateExperiment.nullInterpretation: Observed values above every null world are attraction candidates; observed values below every null world are exclusion candidates.
signedRelationalStateExperiment.directionalSpecificity: absolute holdout lift minus control lift magnitude when the control moves in the same direction

constructionRegimeExperiment.question: Do anonymous sources fall into recurring construction regimes when represented only by the two frozen relational coordinates that already exposed cross-medium outliers?
features: log ratio of rule-2 context mass to rule-1 context mass
constructionRegimeExperiment.selection: deterministic k-means; choose the valid k with maximum mean silhouette, ties favor smaller k

structuralTwinExperiment.question: Which anonymous source objects from different sealed lanes occupy nearly the same relational state despite coming from separately acquired source worlds?
structuralTwinExperiment.featureSpace: the same standardized four-dimensional construction-regime space
structuralTwinExperiment.pairRule: freeze mutual nearest-neighbor pairs across different anonymous lanes
